import Mathlib

/-! Raw squared-variable numerator coefficients for Evans--Veselov--Winn 6.3.
The outer polynomial variable is u=x², the inner one v=y²; w=z² is set to 1.
Homogeneity recovers its exponent a+b-1-i-j. No factorial normalization.
-/
namespace MathGKM.Markov

noncomputable section

abbrev BiPoly := Polynomial (Polynomial ℤ)
def U : BiPoly := Polynomial.X
def V : BiPoly := Polynomial.C Polynomial.X
def S : BiPoly := U + V + 1
def coeff (P : BiPoly) (i j : ℕ) : ℤ := (P.coeff i).coeff j

structure Label where
  a : ℕ
  b : ℕ
  p : BiPoly

structure Frame where
  lo : Label
  mid : Label
  hi : Label

def initial : Frame :=
  ⟨⟨0, 1, 1⟩, ⟨1, 2, (U + V)^2 + U⟩, ⟨1, 1, U + V⟩⟩

def advance (f : Frame) (right : Bool) : Frame :=
  if right then
    ⟨f.mid, ⟨f.mid.a + f.hi.a, f.mid.b + f.hi.b,
      S * f.hi.p * f.mid.p - U^f.hi.a * V^f.hi.b * f.lo.p⟩, f.hi⟩
  else
    ⟨f.lo, ⟨f.lo.a + f.mid.a, f.lo.b + f.mid.b,
      S * f.lo.p * f.mid.p - U^f.lo.a * V^f.lo.b * f.hi.p⟩, f.mid⟩

def frame (path : List Bool) : Frame := path.foldl advance initial

def InPolygon (a b i j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  a * b ≤ b * i + a * j ∧ i + j ≤ a + b - 1

def WeakLC (a b : ℕ) (P : BiPoly) : Prop :=
  (∀ i j, InPolygon a b i j → InPolygon a b (i+1) j →
    InPolygon a b (i+2) j →
    coeff P i j * coeff P (i+2) j ≤ coeff P (i+1) j ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ i j, InPolygon a b i j → InPolygon a b i (j+1) →
    InPolygon a b i (j+2) →
    coeff P i j * coeff P i (j+2) ≤ coeff P i (j+1) ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ i j, InPolygon a b i (j+2) → InPolygon a b (i+1) (j+1) →
    InPolygon a b (i+2) j →
    coeff P i (j+2) * coeff P (i+2) j ≤ coeff P (i+1) (j+1) ^ 2)

/-- Full path-indexed target, not asserted as a theorem. The initial endpoint
0/1 has P=1 and a singleton polygon; 1/1 has P=u+v. -/
def Conjecture63 : Prop :=
  WeakLC 0 1 1 ∧ WeakLC 1 1 (U+V) ∧
  ∀ path, let m := (frame path).mid; WeakLC m.a m.b m.p

end
end MathGKM.Markov
MathGKM/Protocol.lean:
-- Codex/Astra. Executed by machinery.engine as its transition guard.
-- Payload, filesystem atomicity, broker execution and OS costs remain outside this model.
import Lean
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

open Lean
namespace MathGKM.Protocol
structure State where
  pending : Option String := none
  consumed : List String := []
  count : Nat := 0
  limit : Nat := 32
  inflight : Bool := false
  deriving ToJson, FromJson, Repr

inductive Command where
  | issue (id : String)
  | claim (id : String)
  | record
  | finish
  deriving ToJson, FromJson, Repr

def step (s : State) (c : Command) : Option State :=
  match c with
  | .issue id => if s.pending.isNone && !s.inflight then
      some {s with pending := some id} else none
  | .claim id => if s.pending == some id && !s.inflight && !(s.consumed.contains id) then
      some {s with consumed := id :: s.consumed, inflight := true} else none
  | .record => if s.inflight && s.count < s.limit then
      some {s with count := s.count + 1} else none
  | .finish => if s.inflight then some {s with pending := none, inflight := false} else none

theorem preserves_budget (s t : State) (c : Command)
    (h : s.count ≤ s.limit) (accepted : step s c = some t) : t.count ≤ t.limit := by
  cases c <;> simp only [step] at accepted
  all_goals split at accepted <;> simp_all
  all_goals subst t <;> simp_all <;> omega

theorem recorded_only_inflight (s t : State) (h : step s .record = some t) :
    s.inflight = true ∧ t.count = s.count + 1 := by
  simp only [step] at h
  split at h <;> simp_all
  subst t
  rfl

theorem no_replayed_claim (s : State) (id : String) (h : id ∈ s.consumed) :
    step s (.claim id) = none := by
  simp [step, h]

structure Invocation where
  state : State
  command : Command
  deriving FromJson
end MathGKM.Protocol

open Lean MathGKM.Protocol

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  match args with
  | [filename] =>
    let raw ← IO.FS.readFile filename
    match Json.parse raw >>= fromJson? (α := Invocation) with
    | .error e => IO.eprintln e; return 1
    | .ok r =>
      match step r.state r.command with
      | none => IO.eprintln "protocol transition rejected"; return 2
      | some s => IO.println (toJson s).compress; return 0
  | _ => return 1
